easy_mountain_002.canonical: Rise from the flat open meadow on the valley floor north of the mountain hut, fly up the slope toward the pass in the north ridge, cross through it about 40 m above the saddle into the next valley, then land on the high pasture next to the shepherd's hut.
paraphrases: Starting on the level valley-floor meadow just north of the mountain hut, climb the slope to the north ridge's pass, cross it roughly 40 m over the saddle into the neighbouring valley, and settle on the high pasture beside the shepherd's hut.
Lift off from the meadow north of the mountain hut, head uphill to the gap in the north ridge, slip through about 40 m above its lowest point and land on the shepherd's high pasture next to his hut.

Your goal is the high pasture by the shepherd's hut on the far side of the north ridge: depart from the open meadow north of the mountain hut and go over the pass with roughly 40 m of clearance above the saddle.
easy_mountain_002.short: Meadow by the mountain hut, over the north pass 40 m above the saddle, land at the shepherd's hut.

easy_mountain_003.canonical: Rise from the paraglider launch meadow, climb to the pass in the south ridge, trace the crest about 45 m up, for about 410 m, as far as the rounded hill with the observatory on the south side of the valley, and set down on the open grass at the edge of the campsite.
paraphrases: Starting at the paraglider launch meadow, ascend to the pass in the south ridge and follow the crest for roughly 410 m, holding about 45 m above it, until the rounded hill with the observatory on the valley's south side; then land on the open grass at the campsite's edge.

Lift off from the meadow where paragliders take off, reach the south ridge's pass, and track the ridgeline some 410 m toward the south-side rounded hill that carries the observatory, about 45 m over the crest, before setting down on the grassy edge of the campsite.

Follow the south ridge from its pass for about 410 m at roughly 45 m above the crest, as far as the rounded hill topped by the observatory. Begin at the paraglider launch meadow and finish on the open grass at the edge of the campsite.
easy_mountain_003.short: Follow the south ridge 410 m, 45 m above the crest, to the observatory hill.

easy_mountain_004.canonical: Rise from the meadow at the edge of the village, fly to the valley station of the cable car and climb beside the cable car line all the way to the top station, about 22 m off to its left, 15 m above the cables, then touch down on the open meadow on the valley floor near the mountain farm with the red barn and a fenced paddock.
paraphrases: Starting at the meadow on the village's edge, reach the cable car's valley station and ascend alongside the line to the top station with the cables about 22 m off to your right and 15 m below you; then land on the open valley-floor meadow near the red-barn farm with its paddock.

Lift off from the village-edge meadow, fly to the lower cable car station and follow the cables uphill to the upper station, roughly 15 m higher than them and 22 m to their left, before touching down on the valley-floor meadow close to the mountain farm with the red barn.

Climb beside the cable car from the valley station to the top station, about 22 m left of the line and 15 m above the cables. Take off from the meadow at the edge of the village and finish on the open meadow near the farm with the red barn and a fenced paddock.
easy_mountain_004.short: Climb beside the cable car, 22 m left and 15 m above the cables; land near the farm.

easy_mountain_005.canonical: Rise from the flat open meadow on the valley floor north of the farm with the red barn, make your way to the hikers' car park at the trailhead and touch down on the middle of the trailhead car park.
paraphrases: Lift off from the level meadow on the valley floor north of the red-barn farm, fly to the hikers' parking area at the trailhead and land right in the middle of it.
Starting on the open meadow just north of the farm with the red barn, travel to the trailhead car park used by hikers and put the drone down at its centre.
Land in the centre of the trailhead car park; take off for it from the flat valley meadow to the north of the farm whose barn is red.
easy_mountain_005.short: From the meadow north of the red-barn farm to the centre of the trailhead car park.

easy_mountain_006.canonical: Lift off from the flat open meadow on the valley floor at the eastern end of the valley, head for the easternmost rounded hill on the north side of the valley and circle it once counter-clockwise at a radius of about 95 m, keeping the camera on it, then come down on the field beside the farm.
paraphrases: Depart from the level meadow at the valley's east end, fly to the most easterly rounded hill on the northern side, make one counter-clockwise orbit roughly 95 m from it with the camera locked on, then land in the field next to the farm.

From the flat meadow at the eastern end of the valley, go to the eastern rounded hill north of the river, circle it a single time anticlockwise at about 95 m while filming it, and finish in the farm's field.
Orbit the easternmost rounded hill on the north side once, counter-clockwise, about 95 m out and keep it in frame; you start on the open meadow at the east end of the valley and land beside the farm.
easy_mountain_006.short: Circle the eastern north-side hill once anticlockwise at 95 m, land by the farm.

easy_mountain_008.canonical: Lift off from the field beside the farm, head for the mountain village with the church tower and make one full counter-clockwise circle around it about 85 m out, camera pointed at it, and finish by landing on the paraglider launch meadow.
paraphrases: Starting at the field beside the farm, fly to the mountain village with the church tower, circle it once counter-clockwise at roughly 85 m with the camera pointed at it, and land on the paraglider launch meadow.

Lift off from the farm's field, reach the village with the church tower and orbit it a single time counter-clockwise about 85 m away while filming it; then touch down on the meadow where paragliders launch.
Make one counter-clockwise loop of about 85 m around the mountain village with the church tower, keeping it in view. Depart from the field beside the farm and finish on the paraglider launch meadow.
easy_mountain_008.short: Circle the church-tower village once counter-clockwise at 85 m.

easy_mountain_009.canonical: Take off from the open meadow by the river at the eastern end of the valley, make for the farm with the red barn and fly straight across the top of it at about 30 m with the camera tilted down, then come down on the flat open meadow on the valley floor north-east of the farm with the red barn.
paraphrases: Leave the riverside meadow at the eastern end of the valley, fly over the red-barn farm at roughly 30 m with the camera pointed down, and land on the level meadow north-east of that farm.

From the meadow beside the river in the valley's east, head to the farm with the red barn, cross directly above it about 30 m up while looking down, then touch down on the open meadow to its north-east.
Pass straight over the red-barn farm at about 30 m, camera tilted down; the flight starts at the river meadow in the east of the valley and ends on the flat meadow north-east of the farm.
easy_mountain_009.short: Over the red-barn farm at 30 m looking down, land on the meadow north-east of it.

easy_mountain_010.canonical: Take off from the flat open meadow on the valley floor east of the campground with tents and parked cars, head for the campground with tents and parked cars and orbit it once counter-clockwise, about 75 m away, filming it the whole time, and finish by landing on the open meadow on the valley floor near the mountain farm with the red barn and a fenced paddock (the eastern one).
paraphrases: Start on the level meadow east of the campground with its tents and cars, fly one counter-clockwise loop around that campground roughly 75 m out while filming it, and land on the valley meadow by the farm with the red barn and fenced paddock, the eastern of the two.

From the meadow just east of the campground where tents and cars stand, circle the campground once anticlockwise at about 75 m with the camera on it, then put down on the eastern meadow near the red-barn farm and its paddock.

Make a single counter-clockwise orbit of the tent-and-car campground about 75 m away, filming throughout. Take off from the flat meadow to its east and finish on the meadow beside the mountain farm with the red barn and fenced paddock (eastern one).
easy_mountain_010.short: Orbit the campground anticlockwise at 75 m, land by the paddock farm (eastern meadow).

easy_mountain_011.canonical: Rise from the flat clearing on the high ground beyond the south ridge, head over to the hikers' car park at the trailhead and set down precisely on the middle of the trailhead car park.
paraphrases: Lift off from the level clearing up on the high ground past the south ridge, fly to the trailhead car park for hikers and land exactly at its centre.
From the open clearing on high ground behind the south ridge, make your way over to the hikers' trailhead parking and set the drone down precisely in the middle.
The landing point is the very centre of the trailhead car park; begin at the flat clearing on the high ground on the far side of the south ridge.
easy_mountain_011.short: From the clearing beyond the south ridge to the middle of the trailhead car park.

easy_mountain_012.canonical: From the high pasture next to the shepherd's hut, take off, fly to the second rounded hill from the west on the north side of the valley and hover about 80 m short of it, facing it, for 7 seconds, and set down on the flat open meadow on the valley floor at the western end of the valley.
paraphrases: Lift off from the high pasture by the shepherd's hut, fly toward the second rounded hill from the west on the northern side, hover facing it about 80 m away for 7 seconds, then land on the level meadow at the valley's west end.

From the shepherd's high pasture, head for the north side's second rounded hill counting from the west, hold about 80 m in front of it looking at it for 7 seconds, and touch down on the flat meadow in the western part of the valley.

Hover for 7 seconds roughly 80 m short of the second rounded hill from the west on the north side, facing it; you start next to the shepherd's hut and land on the open meadow at the western end of the valley.
easy_mountain_012.short: Hover 80 m from the second north-side hill for 7 seconds, land at the west end.

easy_mountain_013.canonical: From the open meadow by the river at the eastern end of the valley, take off, fly to the mountain hut with the flag and stop about 50 m from it and hover for 6 seconds looking at it, then return to your take-off point and land.
paraphrases: Starting on the riverside meadow at the valley's east end, fly to the mountain hut flying a flag, hold position about 50 m from it watching it for 6 seconds, then return to the start and land.
From the meadow by the river in the east of the valley, go to the flagged mountain hut, hover roughly 50 m away facing it for 6 seconds, and come back to land where you took off.
Watch the mountain hut with the flag for 6 seconds from a hover about 50 m away; the round trip starts and ends on the river meadow at the eastern end of the valley.
easy_mountain_013.short: Hover 50 m from the flagged mountain hut for 6 seconds, return to the start.

easy_mountain_014.canonical: Lift off from the flat open meadow on the valley floor north-east of the small white chapel on the hillside, go to the hikers' car park at the trailhead and circle it once counter-clockwise at a radius of about 50 m, keeping the camera on it, then come down on the lakeshore meadow by the boathouse.
paraphrases: Lift off from the level meadow north-east of the little white hillside chapel, fly to the hikers' trailhead parking, circle it once counter-clockwise about 50 m out with the camera on it, then land on the meadow at the lakeshore by the boathouse.

From the flat meadow north-east of the small white chapel on the slope, go to the trailhead car park, make one anticlockwise orbit at roughly 50 m while filming it, and touch down on the lakeside meadow next to the boathouse.

Orbit the trailhead car park a single time counter-clockwise, about 50 m away, keeping it in view. Start from the meadow north-east of the white chapel on the hillside and end on the lakeshore meadow beside the boathouse.
easy_mountain_014.short: Orbit the trailhead car park anticlockwise at 50 m, land by the boathouse.

easy_mountain_015.canonical: Take off from the open meadow on the valley floor near the alpine refuge, climb toward the pass in the north ridge, go through the gap about 25 m above the lowest point and over to the other side, then set down on the flat clearing on the high ground beyond the pass in the north ridge.
paraphrases: From the valley meadow near the alpine refuge, climb to the pass in the north ridge, go through it about 25 m above its lowest point to the other side, and land on the level clearing on the high ground beyond that pass.
Lift off from the open meadow by the alpine refuge, head up to the north ridge's gap, cross roughly 25 m over the saddle, and set down on the flat clearing up on the far side of the pass.
Cross the pass in the north ridge with about 25 m of clearance above the low point. Take off from the meadow near the alpine refuge and land on the open clearing on the high ground past that pass.
easy_mountain_015.short: Refuge meadow, through the north pass 25 m above the saddle, land on the clearing beyond.

easy_mountain_016.canonical: Lift off from the open meadow by the river at the western end of the valley, head for the observatory on top of the westernmost snow-capped peak on the south side of the valley and pass directly over it about 35 m above, camera looking down, then land on the flat open meadow on the valley floor west of the hikers' car park at the trailhead.
paraphrases: Starting on the riverside meadow at the valley's west end, fly to the observatory on the westernmost snowy peak of the south side, pass right over it about 35 m above with the camera looking down, and land on the level meadow west of the trailhead car park.

From the meadow by the river in the western valley, head to the observatory crowning the south side's westernmost snow-capped peak, overfly it at roughly 35 m looking down, then touch down on the flat meadow to the west of the hikers' car park.

Fly directly above the observatory on top of the westernmost snow-capped peak south of the valley, about 35 m over it with the camera pointed down; start at the river meadow in the west and land west of the trailhead car park.
easy_mountain_016.short: Over the westernmost south-side observatory at 35 m, land west of the trailhead car park.

easy_mountain_017.canonical: Lift off from the field beside the farm, fly to the trailhead car park and orbit it once counter-clockwise, about 65 m away, filming it the whole time, then return to your take-off point and land.
paraphrases: Depart from the field beside the farm, fly to the trailhead car park, orbit it once counter-clockwise roughly 65 m away while filming it, and then fly back to land at your starting point.
Lift off at the farm's field, reach the trailhead parking and circle it a single time counter-clockwise at about 65 m with the camera on it, before returning to the field to land.
Make one counter-clockwise lap of about 65 m around the trailhead car park, filming it throughout. Start and finish on the field beside the farm.
easy_mountain_017.short: Orbit the trailhead car park once counter-clockwise at 65 m; land back at the start.

easy_mountain_018.canonical: Rise from the flat open meadow on the valley floor east of the hikers' car park at the trailhead, head for the hikers' car park at the trailhead and cross right over it roughly 35 m up, looking down at it, then land on the meadow at the edge of the village.
paraphrases: Lift off from the level meadow east of the hikers' trailhead car park, fly across directly above that car park at about 35 m looking down, and land on the meadow at the village's edge.
From the open meadow to the east of the trailhead parking, head straight over the car park roughly 35 m up with the camera aimed down, then put down on the meadow bordering the village.
Overfly the trailhead car park at about 35 m with the camera facing down. You take off from the flat meadow just east of it and land on the meadow at the edge of the village.
easy_mountain_018.short: Over the trailhead car park at 35 m looking down, land at the village edge.

easy_mountain_019.canonical: From the open grass at the edge of the campsite, take off, fly down to the river near the campground with tents and parked cars and trace the river upstream, heading east, for about 310 m at about 25 m above it, and set down on the paraglider launch meadow.
paraphrases: Starting from the open grass at the campsite's edge, drop down to the river near the campground with tents and parked cars and follow it upstream eastward for roughly 310 m about 25 m above the water, then land on the paraglider launch meadow.

Lift off at the grassy edge of the campsite, reach the river beside the tent-and-car campground, and track it upstream toward the east for some 310 m at around 25 m over it; finish on the meadow where paragliders launch.

Fly about 310 m upstream along the river toward the east, roughly 25 m above the water, beginning near the campground with tents and parked cars. Take off from the open grass at the edge of the campsite and land on the paraglider launch meadow.
easy_mountain_019.short: Follow the river upstream east 310 m at 25 m above the water.

easy_mountain_020.canonical: Rise from the high pasture next to the shepherd's hut, fly to the third snow-capped peak from the west on the north side of the valley and hold position roughly 95 m away and watch it for 6 seconds, then fly back and land where you took off.
paraphrases: Starting on the high pasture by the shepherd's hut, fly toward the third snowy peak from the west on the northern side, hover roughly 95 m from it watching it for 6 seconds, then fly back and land at the start.
From the shepherd's high pasture, go to the north side's third snow-capped peak counting from the west, hold about 95 m away facing it for 6 seconds, and return to land where you lifted off.
Hover for 6 seconds about 95 m from the third snow-capped peak from the west on the north side, looking at it; the flight begins and ends beside the shepherd's hut.
easy_mountain_020.short: Hover 95 m from the third north-side peak for 6 seconds, return to the shepherd's hut.

easy_mountain_021.canonical: Take off at the open grass at the edge of the campsite, head over to the hikers' car park at the trailhead and set down precisely on the middle of the trailhead car park.
paraphrases: Lift off from the grass on the edge of the campsite, fly to the hikers' trailhead parking and land exactly in the middle of the car park.
From the open grass at the campsite's edge, make your way over to the trailhead car park and put the drone down right at its centre.
Touch down precisely in the centre of the trailhead car park, starting from the grassy ground bordering the campsite.
easy_mountain_021.short: From the campsite grass to the centre of the trailhead car park.

easy_mountain_022.canonical: From the middle of the trailhead car park, take off, go to the riverbank near the hikers' car park at the trailhead and fly upstream along the river toward the east for roughly 390 m, staying about 20 m over the water, and come back to land where you started.
paraphrases: Starting in the middle of the trailhead car park, fly to the riverbank by the hikers' car park, follow the river upstream eastward for roughly 390 m about 20 m above the water, and then return to land where you started.

Lift off from the centre of the trailhead parking, reach the river beside the hikers' car park and track it upstream toward the east for some 390 m while staying around 20 m over the water; finally fly back to your take-off spot and land.

Fly about 390 m upstream along the river to the east at roughly 20 m above the water, starting at the bank near the hikers' car park. Take off from and land back in the middle of the trailhead car park.
easy_mountain_022.short: Follow the river upstream east 390 m at 20 m above the water; land back at the start.

easy_mountain_023.canonical: Take off at the field beside the farm, head up to the pass in the north ridge, fly over the saddle roughly 35 m above the ground and drop into the valley beyond, and land on the flat clearing on the high ground beyond the pass in the north ridge.
paraphrases: From the field next to the farm, climb to the pass in the north ridge, cross the saddle about 35 m above the ground into the valley beyond, and land on the level clearing on the high ground past that pass.
Lift off from the farm's field, head up to the gap in the north ridge, fly over its saddle at roughly 35 m, drop down the other side and set down on the flat clearing beyond the pass.
Go over the north-ridge pass with about 35 m between you and the saddle; start in the field beside the farm and land on the open clearing on the high ground on the far side.
easy_mountain_023.short: Farm field, over the north pass 35 m above the saddle, land on the clearing beyond.

easy_mountain_024.canonical: Take off from the flat clearing on the high ground beyond the south ridge at the western end of the valley, go to the peak with the radio mast on the north side of the valley and make one full counter-clockwise circle around it about 120 m out, camera pointed at it, then return to your take-off point and land.
paraphrases: Lift off from the level clearing on the high ground beyond the south ridge in the west of the valley, fly to the peak carrying the radio mast on the north side, circle it once counter-clockwise about 120 m away with the camera on it, then return and land at the start.

From the flat clearing past the south ridge at the valley's western end, go to the north side's radio-mast peak, make one full anticlockwise orbit roughly 120 m out while filming it, and come back to land where you began.
Orbit the peak with the radio mast on the north side once, counter-clockwise, at about 120 m, keeping it in frame; the trip starts and ends on the clearing beyond the south ridge at the western end.
easy_mountain_024.short: Orbit the north-side radio-mast peak anticlockwise at 120 m, return to the start.

easy_mountain_025.canonical: Rise from the open meadow on the valley floor near the small white chapel on the hillside, head toward the summit cross on top of the highest snow-capped peak on the north side of the valley and hold position roughly 45 m away and watch it for 8 seconds, then touch down on the flat open meadow on the valley floor east of the campsite with colourful tents.
paraphrases: Starting on the valley meadow near the small white chapel on the slope, fly toward the summit cross on the north side's highest snowy peak, hover about 45 m from it watching it for 8 seconds, then land on the level meadow east of the campsite with colourful tents.

From the open meadow by the little white hillside chapel, go to the summit cross atop the highest snow-capped peak north of the valley, hold roughly 45 m away facing it for 8 seconds, and touch down on the flat meadow east of the colourful-tent campsite.

Watch the summit cross on the highest snow-capped peak of the north side for 8 seconds from about 45 m; take off near the white chapel on the hillside and land on the meadow east of the campsite with the bright tents.
easy_mountain_025.short: Hover 45 m from the north-side summit cross for 8 seconds, land east of the campsite.

easy_mountain_026.canonical: Take off from the paraglider launch meadow, gain height and reach the south ridge at the westernmost pale rock tower on the south side of the valley, fly along the ridgeline about 50 m above the rocks for roughly 440 m until the pass in the south ridge, then come down on the flat open meadow on the valley floor south-east of the mountain rescue station with the helicopter.
paraphrases: From the paraglider launch meadow, climb to the south ridge at the westernmost pale rock tower on the southern side, follow the crest roughly 50 m above the rock for about 440 m to the pass in the south ridge, and land on the level meadow south-east of the mountain rescue station with the helicopter.

Lift off at the paragliders' launch meadow, gain height to reach the south ridge at its most westerly pale rock tower, fly the ridgeline about 50 m over the rocks for some 440 m until the south pass, then set down on the flat meadow south-east of the rescue station and its helicopter.

Follow the south ridge for about 440 m, roughly 50 m above the rocks, from the westernmost pale rock tower to the pass in that ridge. Start at the paraglider launch meadow and finish on the meadow south-east of the mountain rescue station with the helicopter.
easy_mountain_026.short: South crest 440 m at 50 m from the pale tower to the pass, land by the rescue station.

easy_mountain_027.canonical: Lift off from the open meadow on the valley floor near the alpine refuge, head for the mountain rescue station with the helicopter and pass directly over it about 40 m above, camera looking down, then return to your take-off point and land.
paraphrases: Starting at the open valley-floor meadow near the alpine refuge, fly to the mountain rescue station with the helicopter, cross straight over it roughly 40 m above with the camera pointing down, and return to land at your starting point.
Lift off from the meadow on the valley floor close to the alpine refuge, overfly the rescue station and its helicopter at about 40 m while looking down at it, then fly back to the meadow and land.
Pass directly over the mountain rescue station with the helicopter at around 40 m, camera tilted down. Start and finish on the open valley-floor meadow near the alpine refuge.
easy_mountain_027.short: Overfly the rescue station at about 40 m, camera down; land back at the start.

easy_mountain_029.canonical: Rise from the open grass at the edge of the campsite, fly to the trailhead car park and hover about 50 m short of it, facing it, for 8 seconds, and finish by landing on the flat open meadow on the valley floor west of the village of wooden chalets around a white church.
paraphrases: Lift off from the grass at the campsite's edge, fly toward the trailhead car park, hover roughly 50 m in front of it facing it for 8 seconds, then land on the level meadow west of the village of wooden chalets around the white church.

From the open grass bordering the campsite, go to the trailhead car park, hold about 50 m short of it looking at it for 8 seconds, and touch down on the flat meadow to the west of the chalet village with the white church.
Hover for 8 seconds about 50 m from the trailhead car park, facing it; start on the campsite's grassy edge and finish on the meadow west of the wooden-chalet village gathered around a white church.
easy_mountain_029.short: Hover 50 m from the trailhead car park for 8 seconds, land west of the chalet village.

easy_mountain_030.canonical: Take off from the meadow at the edge of the village, go to the cable car's valley station and climb beside the cable car line all the way to the top station, about 26 m off to its right, 25 m above the cables, then touch down on the open meadow on the valley floor near the mountain village with the church tower (the western one).
paraphrases: The job is a climb beside the cable car: start at its valley station and keep about 26 m to the right of the line and 25 m over the cables until the top station. Before that, take off from the village-edge meadow; afterwards land on the western meadow close to the mountain village whose church has a tower.

Lift off from the meadow bordering the village, go to the lower cable car station, follow the line up to the top station keeping roughly 26 m off to the right and 25 m higher than the cables, and touch down on the western meadow beside the mountain village with the church tower.

Climb beside the cable car line from the valley station to the top station, about 26 m to its right and 25 m above the cables. Take off at the village-edge meadow and land on the meadow near the church-tower village (western one).
easy_mountain_030.short: Up the cable car line 26 m to its right, 25 m above, land near the church-tower village (west).

easy_mountain_031.canonical: Take off from the meadow at the edge of the village, approach the cable car and stop about 55 m from it and hover for 5 seconds looking at it, and finish by landing on the flat open meadow on the valley floor south of the village of wooden chalets around a white church.
paraphrases: Lift off from the meadow at the village edge, approach the cable car, hover about 55 m away watching it for 5 seconds, then land on the level meadow south of the village of wooden chalets around the white church.
From the meadow bordering the village, go up to the cable car, hold roughly 55 m from it facing it for 5 seconds, and touch down on the flat meadow south of the chalet village with the white church.

Hover for 5 seconds about 55 m from the cable car, looking at it; start on the meadow at the edge of the village and finish on the meadow to the south of the wooden-chalet village around a white church.
easy_mountain_031.short: Hover 55 m from the cable car for 5 seconds, land south of the chalet village.

easy_mountain_032.canonical: Rise from the open grass at the edge of the campsite, gain height and reach the pass in the north ridge, trace the crest about 40 m up, for about 230 m, as far as the second snow-capped peak from the west on the north side of the valley, then touch down on the middle of the trailhead car park.
paraphrases: Depart from the open grass at the campsite's edge, climb to the pass in the north ridge, follow the crest roughly 230 m to the second snow-capped peak from the west while holding about 40 m above it, and land in the middle of the trailhead car park.

Lift off at the grassy edge of the campsite, reach the north ridge's pass and trace the ridgeline some 230 m to the north side's second snowy peak from the west, around 40 m over the crest; then touch down at the centre of the trailhead parking.

Follow the north ridge for about 230 m at roughly 40 m above the crest, from the pass to the second snow-capped peak from the west. Take off from the open grass at the edge of the campsite and finish in the middle of the trailhead car park.
easy_mountain_032.short: Follow the north ridge 230 m, 40 m above the crest, from the pass to the second snowy peak.

easy_mountain_033.canonical: From the open meadow on the valley floor near the hikers' car park at the trailhead, take off, make for the observatory on top of the highest snow-capped peak on the north side of the valley and cross right over it roughly 35 m up, looking down at it, and set down on the open grass at the edge of the campsite.
paraphrases: Starting from the open valley-floor meadow near the hikers' trailhead car park, head to the observatory on the highest snow-capped peak of the north side, overfly it at roughly 35 m with the camera looking down, and land on the open grass at the campsite's edge.

Lift off at the meadow on the valley floor close to the hikers' car park, cross directly over the observatory crowning the north side's highest snowy peak about 35 m above it, camera tilted down, then touch down on the grassy edge of the campsite.

Pass straight over the observatory on top of the highest snow-capped peak on the north side at around 35 m, looking down at it. Depart from the valley-floor meadow near the hikers' car park at the trailhead and finish on the open grass at the edge of the campsite.
easy_mountain_033.short: Overfly the observatory on the highest north peak at about 35 m, camera down.

easy_mountain_034.canonical: Rise from the flat open meadow on the valley floor at the western end of the valley, fly to the summit cross on top of the highest snow-capped rock tower on the north side of the valley and make one full clockwise circle around it about 45 m out, camera pointed at it, and set down on the paraglider launch meadow.
paraphrases: Starting on the level meadow at the valley's west end, fly to the summit cross on the north side's highest snowy rock tower, circle it once clockwise about 45 m out with the camera on it, and land on the paraglider launch meadow.

From the flat meadow in the western part of the valley, go to the summit cross atop the tallest snow-capped rock tower north of the valley, make one full clockwise orbit at roughly 45 m while filming it, then put down on the paragliders' launch meadow.

Orbit the summit cross on the highest snow-capped rock tower of the north side once, clockwise, about 45 m away, keeping it in frame; take off at the western valley meadow and land on the paraglider launch meadow.
easy_mountain_034.short: Orbit the north-side tower's summit cross clockwise at 45 m, land at the paraglider launch.

easy_mountain_035.canonical: Take off from the middle of the trailhead car park, fly up to the north ridge at the easternmost pale rock tower on the north side of the valley, trace the crest about 50 m up, for about 310 m, as far as the pass in the north ridge, and finish by landing on the paraglider launch meadow.
paraphrases: Starting in the middle of the trailhead car park, climb to the north ridge at its easternmost pale rock tower, follow the crest roughly 310 m to the pass in the north ridge while staying about 50 m above it, and land on the paraglider launch meadow.

Lift off from the centre of the trailhead parking, gain the north ridge at the pale rock tower furthest east, and trace the ridgeline some 310 m to the north ridge's pass at around 50 m over the crest; then touch down on the meadow where paragliders launch.

Follow the north ridge for about 310 m at roughly 50 m above the crest, from the easternmost pale rock tower to the pass. Take off from the middle of the trailhead car park and finish on the paraglider launch meadow.
easy_mountain_035.short: Follow the north ridge 310 m, 50 m up, from the east tower to the pass.

easy_mountain_036.canonical: Lift off from the flat open meadow on the valley floor north-west of the cable car, head for the top station of the cable car and pass directly over it about 35 m above, camera looking down, then land on the flat open meadow on the valley floor south-west of the alpine village with the white church.
paraphrases: Lift off from the level meadow north-west of the cable car, fly to the cable car's top station and pass right over it about 35 m above with the camera looking down, then land on the flat meadow south-west of the alpine village with the white church.

From the open meadow to the north-west of the cable car, head for its upper station, overfly it at roughly 35 m with the camera aimed down, and touch down on the meadow south-west of the white-church alpine village.

Fly directly over the cable car's top station about 35 m above it, camera pointing down. Start on the meadow north-west of the cable car and finish on the meadow south-west of the alpine village with the white church.
easy_mountain_036.short: Over the cable car top station at 35 m looking down, land south-west of the village.

easy_mountain_037.canonical: From the flat open meadow on the valley floor north-east of the farm with the red barn, take off, head toward the observatory on top of the westernmost rounded hill on the north side of the valley and hold position roughly 50 m away and watch it for 8 seconds, and finish by landing on the open meadow on the valley floor near the paraglider launch site with the windsock.
paraphrases: Starting on the level meadow north-east of the red-barn farm, fly toward the observatory on the westernmost rounded hill of the north side, hover roughly 50 m from it watching it for 8 seconds, then land on the valley meadow near the paraglider launch site with the windsock.

From the flat meadow north-east of the farm with the red barn, go to the observatory crowning the north side's most westerly rounded hill, hold about 50 m away facing it for 8 seconds, and touch down on the meadow by the paraglider launch with its windsock.

Watch the observatory on the westernmost rounded hill north of the valley for 8 seconds from about 50 m; take off north-east of the red-barn farm and land on the meadow near the windsock at the paraglider launch.
easy_mountain_037.short: Hover 50 m from the north-side observatory for 8 seconds, land by the paraglider windsock.

easy_mountain_038.canonical: Lift off from the meadow at the edge of the village, fly up to the south ridge at the westernmost peak on the south side of the valley, fly along the ridgeline about 25 m above the rocks for roughly 230 m until the highest snow-capped peak with the summit cross on the south side of the valley, then land on the high pasture next to the shepherd's hut.
paraphrases: From the meadow at the village edge, fly up to the south ridge at the westernmost peak on the southern side, follow the crest about 25 m above the rocks for roughly 230 m to the highest snowy peak with the summit cross, then land on the high pasture by the shepherd's hut.

Lift off from the meadow bordering the village, reach the south ridge at its most westerly peak, fly the ridgeline some 230 m at around 25 m over the rock until the highest snow-capped peak carrying the summit cross, and set down on the shepherd's high pasture.

Follow the south ridge for about 230 m, roughly 25 m above the rocks, from the westernmost peak to the highest snow-capped peak with the summit cross. Start on the village-edge meadow and finish beside the shepherd's hut.
easy_mountain_038.short: South crest 230 m at 25 m to the summit-cross peak, land by the shepherd's hut.

easy_mountain_039.canonical: Rise from the flat open meadow on the valley floor south-west of the campsite with colourful tents, make your way to the campsite with colourful tents and touch down on the open grass at the edge of the campsite.
paraphrases: Lift off from the level valley meadow south-west of the campsite with colourful tents, fly over to that campsite and land on the grass along its edge.
From the open meadow to the south-west of the colourful-tent campsite, make your way to the campsite and put the drone down on the open grass bordering it.
Your landing spot is the grassy edge of the campsite with the bright tents; take off from the flat meadow on the valley floor south-west of it.
easy_mountain_039.short: From the meadow south-west of the campsite to the grass at its edge.

easy_mountain_040.canonical: Take off at the open grass at the edge of the campsite, go to the riverbank near the campsite with colourful tents and follow the river upstream (west) for about 260 m, about 25 m above the water, and set down on the open meadow on the valley floor near the campsite with colourful tents.
paraphrases: Starting at the open grass on the campsite's edge, fly to the riverbank by the campsite with colourful tents and follow the river upstream westward for roughly 260 m about 25 m above the water, then land on the open valley-floor meadow near that campsite.

Lift off from the grassy edge of the campsite, reach the river next to the colourful-tent campsite, and track it upstream toward the west for some 260 m at around 25 m over the water; finish on the open meadow on the valley floor close to the campsite.

Fly about 260 m upstream along the river to the west, roughly 25 m above the water, beginning by the campsite with colourful tents. Take off from the open grass at the campsite's edge and land on the valley-floor meadow near the campsite.
easy_mountain_040.short: Follow the river upstream west 260 m at 25 m above the water.

easy_mountain_041.canonical: Take off from the field beside the farm, go to the riverbank near the campsite with colourful tents and trace the river upstream, heading east, for about 390 m at about 25 m above it, then land on the paraglider launch meadow.
paraphrases: Head out from the farm's field to the stretch of river beside the colourful-tent camp, then work your way upstream to the east for some 390 m holding roughly 25 m of height over the water, and finish at the paragliders' take-off meadow.

Lift off at the farm's field, reach the river by the colourful-tent campsite and track it upstream toward the east for some 390 m at around 25 m over the water, then touch down on the meadow where paragliders launch.

Fly about 390 m upstream along the river toward the east at roughly 25 m above the water, starting near the campsite with colourful tents. Take off from the field beside the farm and finish on the paraglider launch meadow.
easy_mountain_041.short: Follow the river upstream east 390 m at 25 m above the water.

easy_mountain_042.canonical: Lift off from the open grass at the edge of the campsite, make for the hikers' car park at the trailhead and cross right over it roughly 35 m up, looking down at it, then come down on the open meadow on the valley floor near the campsite with colourful tents.
paraphrases: Starting from the open grass at the campsite's edge, head to the hikers' car park at the trailhead and overfly it at roughly 35 m with the camera looking down, then land on the open valley-floor meadow near the campsite with colourful tents.

Lift off at the grassy edge of the campsite, cross straight over the trailhead parking for hikers about 35 m above it while looking down, and touch down on the open meadow on the valley floor close to the colourful-tent campsite.

Pass directly over the hikers' car park at the trailhead at around 35 m, camera tilted down at it. Depart from the open grass at the edge of the campsite and finish on the valley-floor meadow near the campsite with colourful tents.
easy_mountain_042.short: Overfly the trailhead car park at about 35 m, camera down.

easy_mountain_043.canonical: Take off from the paraglider launch meadow, go to the westernmost snow-capped peak on the south side of the valley and circle it once clockwise at a radius of about 100 m, keeping the camera on it, then land on the field beside the farm.
paraphrases: From the paraglider launch meadow, fly to the westernmost snowy peak on the south side, orbit it once clockwise roughly 100 m out with the camera on it, then land in the field beside the farm.
Lift off at the paragliders' launch meadow, go to the south side's most westerly snow-capped peak, make a single clockwise circle at about 100 m while filming it, and touch down in the farm's field.
Circle the westernmost snow-capped peak south of the valley once, clockwise, about 100 m away, keeping it in view; start at the paraglider launch meadow and finish in the field next to the farm.
easy_mountain_043.short: Orbit the westernmost south-side peak clockwise at 100 m, land by the farm.

easy_mountain_044.canonical: Rise from the flat clearing on the high ground beyond the south ridge, fly up the slope toward the pass in the north ridge, go through the gap about 35 m above the lowest point and over to the other side, then set down on the flat clearing on the high ground beyond the pass in the north ridge.
paraphrases: Lift off from the level clearing on the high ground beyond the south ridge, climb across to the pass in the north ridge, go through it about 35 m above the low point to the far side, and land on the clearing on the high ground beyond that pass.
From the flat clearing behind the south ridge, head up the slope to the north ridge's gap, cross roughly 35 m over the saddle, and set down on the open clearing up past the north pass.
Cross the pass in the north ridge with about 35 m of clearance over its lowest point. You start on the clearing beyond the south ridge and land on the clearing beyond the north pass.
easy_mountain_044.short: From beyond the south ridge, through the north pass 35 m up, to the clearing beyond it.

easy_mountain_045.canonical: Rise from the middle of the trailhead car park, climb to the pass in the north ridge, fly along the ridgeline about 35 m above the rocks for roughly 370 m until the easternmost snow-capped peak on the north side of the valley, then land on the meadow at the edge of the village.
paraphrases: From the centre of the trailhead car park, climb to the pass in the north ridge, follow the crest about 35 m above the rocks for roughly 370 m to the easternmost snowy peak on the northern side, then land on the meadow at the village edge.

Lift off in the middle of the trailhead parking, reach the north ridge at its pass, fly the ridgeline some 370 m at around 35 m over the rock until the most easterly snow-capped peak, and touch down on the meadow bordering the village.

Follow the north ridge for about 370 m, roughly 35 m above the rocks, from its pass to the easternmost snow-capped peak on the north side. Start at the trailhead car park and finish at the edge of the village.
easy_mountain_045.short: North crest 370 m at 35 m from the pass to the eastern peak, land at the village edge.

easy_mountain_046.canonical: Lift off from the flat open meadow on the valley floor south of the campsite with colourful tents, fly to the campsite with colourful tents and circle it once counter-clockwise at a radius of about 75 m, keeping the camera on it, then land on the flat open meadow on the valley floor west of the mountain rescue station with the helicopter.
paraphrases: Lift off from the level meadow south of the campsite with colourful tents, fly to that campsite and circle it once counter-clockwise about 75 m out with the camera on it, then land on the flat meadow west of the mountain rescue station with the helicopter.

From the open meadow south of the colourful-tent campsite, go to the campsite, make one anticlockwise orbit at roughly 75 m while filming it, and touch down on the meadow to the west of the rescue station and its helicopter.

Orbit the campsite with the bright tents once, counter-clockwise, about 75 m away, keeping it in frame; take off on the meadow south of it and land on the meadow west of the mountain rescue station with the helicopter.
easy_mountain_046.short: Orbit the colourful-tent campsite anticlockwise at 75 m, land west of the rescue station.

easy_mountain_047.canonical: Take off at the flat clearing on the high ground beyond the north ridge, fly to the trailhead car park and stop about 45 m from it and hover for 5 seconds looking at it, and set down on the high pasture next to the shepherd's hut.
paraphrases: Starting on the level clearing on the high ground beyond the north ridge, fly toward the trailhead car park, hover about 45 m from it watching it for 5 seconds, then land on the high pasture next to the shepherd's hut.
From the flat clearing behind the north ridge, go to the trailhead car park, hold roughly 45 m away facing it for 5 seconds, and set down on the shepherd's high pasture beside his hut.
Hover for 5 seconds about 45 m from the trailhead car park, looking at it; you start on the clearing beyond the north ridge and land on the high pasture by the shepherd's hut.
easy_mountain_047.short: Hover 45 m from the trailhead car park for 5 seconds, land at the shepherd's hut.

easy_mountain_048.canonical: Lift off from the open grass at the edge of the campsite, head for the hikers' car park at the trailhead and orbit it once counter-clockwise, about 70 m away, filming it the whole time, and set down on the flat clearing on the high ground beyond the north ridge.
paraphrases: Lift off from the grass at the campsite's edge, fly to the hikers' trailhead parking, orbit it once counter-clockwise at about 70 m while filming it, and land on the level clearing on the high ground beyond the north ridge.

From the open grass bordering the campsite, go to the trailhead car park, make a single anticlockwise circle roughly 70 m out with the camera on it, then set down on the flat clearing past the north ridge.
Circle the trailhead car park once, counter-clockwise, about 70 m away, keeping it in view. Start on the campsite's grassy edge and finish on the clearing on the high ground behind the north ridge.
easy_mountain_048.short: Orbit the trailhead car park anticlockwise at 70 m, land beyond the north ridge.

easy_mountain_049.canonical: From the open meadow on the valley floor near the mountain rescue station with the helicopter (the eastern one), take off, head for the dark green wooden boathouse with the wooden jetty and fly straight across the top of it at about 45 m with the camera tilted down, then land on the flat open meadow on the valley floor north-east of the dark green wooden boathouse with the wooden jetty.
paraphrases: Starting on the valley meadow near the mountain rescue station with the helicopter, the eastern one, fly across directly above the dark green wooden boathouse with the jetty at about 45 m, camera tilted down, and land on the level meadow north-east of that boathouse.

From the open meadow by the rescue station and its helicopter (eastern meadow), head to the dark green boathouse with the wooden jetty, overfly it roughly 45 m up looking down, then touch down on the flat meadow to its north-east.

Pass straight over the dark green wooden boathouse and its jetty about 45 m above, with the camera facing down; take off on the eastern meadow near the rescue station with the helicopter and land north-east of the boathouse.
easy_mountain_049.short: Over the dark green boathouse at 45 m looking down, land on the meadow north-east of it.

easy_mountain_050.canonical: Lift off from the meadow at the edge of the village, go to the east shore of the lake and cross the full 510 m of water heading west, about 20 m above the surface, then land on the lakeshore meadow by the boathouse.
paraphrases: Starting at the meadow on the village's edge, fly to the lake's eastern shore, then cross the entire 510 m of water westward at roughly 20 m above the surface, and land on the lakeshore meadow by the boathouse.

Lift off from the village-edge meadow, reach the east shore of the lake and skim the full 510 m across it toward the west, about 20 m over the water; finish by touching down on the meadow beside the boathouse.

Cross the whole lake from its east shore to the west, about 510 m, roughly 20 m above the surface. Take off from the meadow at the edge of the village and land on the lakeshore meadow by the boathouse.
easy_mountain_050.short: Cross the lake west from its east shore, 510 m at 20 m above the water.

easy_mountain_051.canonical: Lift off from the open meadow on the valley floor near the mountain rescue station with the helicopter, make for the valley station of the cable car and fly straight across the top of it at about 30 m with the camera tilted down, and finish by landing on the flat open meadow on the valley floor east of the campsite with colourful tents.
paraphrases: Lift off from the valley meadow near the mountain rescue station with the helicopter, fly straight over the cable car's valley station at about 30 m with the camera tilted down, and land on the level meadow east of the campsite with colourful tents.

From the open meadow by the rescue station and its helicopter, head to the lower station of the cable car, cross directly above it roughly 30 m up looking down, then touch down on the flat meadow east of the colourful-tent campsite.

Overfly the cable car's valley station at about 30 m, camera aimed down; you start on the meadow near the mountain rescue station with the helicopter and land on the meadow to the east of the bright-tent campsite.
easy_mountain_051.short: Over the cable car valley station at 30 m looking down, land east of the campsite.

easy_mountain_052.canonical: Rise from the open meadow on the valley floor near the campground with tents and parked cars, line up on the campground with tents and parked cars and cross right over it roughly 35 m up, looking down at it, and come back to land where you started.
paraphrases: Starting on the valley meadow near the campground with tents and parked cars, line up on that campground, fly directly over it about 35 m up with the camera looking down, then return and land at the start.
From the open meadow by the tent-and-car campground, head straight across the top of the campground at roughly 35 m while looking down at it, and come back to land where you lifted off.
Overfly the campground with tents and parked cars at about 35 m, camera pointing down; the round trip starts and ends on the meadow next to it.
easy_mountain_052.short: Over the tent-and-car campground at 35 m looking down, then back to the start.

easy_mountain_053.canonical: Take off from the flat open meadow on the valley floor south-west of the alpine village with the white church, fly to the farm with the red barn and stop about 60 m from it and hover for 7 seconds looking at it, and come back to land where you started.
paraphrases: Lift off from the level meadow south-west of the alpine village with the white church, fly toward the red-barn farm, hover about 60 m from it watching it for 7 seconds, then return to the start and land.
From the flat meadow to the south-west of the white-church alpine village, go to the farm with the red barn, hold roughly 60 m away facing it for 7 seconds, and come back to land where you began.
Watch the farm with the red barn for 7 seconds from a hover about 60 m away; take off and land on the meadow south-west of the alpine village with the white church.
easy_mountain_053.short: Hover 60 m from the red-barn farm for 7 seconds, return to the meadow by the village.

easy_mountain_054.canonical: Rise from the meadow at the edge of the village, climb to the pass in the north ridge, follow the crest, about 45 m above it, for about 380 m to the easternmost snow-capped peak on the north side of the valley, and finish by landing on the lakeshore meadow by the boathouse.
paraphrases: From the meadow bordering the village, climb up to the north ridge's pass, then follow the crest eastward roughly 45 m above it for some 380 m until the most easterly snow-capped peak on that side, and land on the meadow by the boathouse at the lake.

Lift off at the village-edge meadow, reach the gap in the north ridge, track the ridgeline about 45 m over the rock for around 380 m to the easternmost snowy peak north of the valley, then set down on the lakeside meadow next to the boathouse.

Follow the north crest for about 380 m, roughly 45 m above it, from the pass to the easternmost snow-capped peak on the north side. You start at the edge of the village and finish on the lakeshore meadow beside the boathouse.
easy_mountain_054.short: North crest 380 m at 45 m from the pass to the eastern peak, land by the boathouse.

easy_mountain_055.canonical: From the paraglider launch meadow, take off, head for the campground with tents and parked cars and circle it once counter-clockwise at a radius of about 65 m, keeping the camera on it, and finish by landing on the meadow at the edge of the village.
paraphrases: From the paraglider launch meadow, fly to the campground with tents and parked cars, orbit it once counter-clockwise roughly 65 m out with the camera on it, and land on the meadow at the edge of the village.
Lift off at the paragliders' launch meadow, go to the tent-and-car campground, make one anticlockwise circle at about 65 m while filming it, then set down on the meadow bordering the village.
Circle the campground with tents and parked cars once, counter-clockwise, about 65 m away, keeping it in frame; start at the paraglider launch and finish at the village edge.
easy_mountain_055.short: Orbit the tent-and-car campground anticlockwise at 65 m, land at the village edge.

easy_mountain_056.canonical: From the high pasture next to the shepherd's hut, take off, approach the easternmost peak with the radio mast on the north side of the valley and hover about 110 m short of it, facing it, for 7 seconds, then come down on the open meadow on the valley floor near the campground with tents and parked cars.
paraphrases: Depart from the high pasture beside the shepherd's hut, fly toward the easternmost peak on the north side, the one carrying the radio mast, hover roughly 110 m from it facing it for 7 seconds, and land on the open valley-floor meadow near the campground with tents and parked cars.

Lift off at the shepherd's high pasture, approach the radio-mast peak at the east end of the north side and hold about 110 m short of it while watching it for 7 seconds; finish on the meadow on the valley floor close to the tent-and-car campground.

Watch the easternmost north-side peak with the radio mast for 7 seconds from about 110 m, facing it. Take off from the high pasture next to the shepherd's hut and land on the valley-floor meadow near the campground with tents and parked cars.
easy_mountain_056.short: Watch the east radio-mast peak for 7 seconds from 110 m.

easy_mountain_057.canonical: Take off at the field beside the farm, fly to the campsite with colourful tents and touch down on the open grass at the edge of the campsite.
paraphrases: Lift off from the field next to the farm, fly over to the campsite with colourful tents and land on the grass along its edge.
From the farm's field, make your way to the colourful-tent campsite and put the drone down on the open grass bordering it.
Land on the grassy edge of the campsite with the bright tents, taking off from the field beside the farm.
easy_mountain_057.short: From the farm field to the grass at the edge of the colourful-tent campsite.

easy_mountain_058.canonical: From the meadow at the edge of the village, take off, fly down to the river near the village of wooden chalets around a white church and fly downstream along the river toward the west for roughly 460 m, staying about 15 m over the water, then touch down on the field beside the farm.
paraphrases: From the meadow on the village's edge, drop down to the river near the chalet village with the white church, follow it downstream westward for roughly 460 m about 15 m above the water, and land on the field beside the farm.

Lift off at the village-edge meadow, reach the river by the village of wooden chalets and its white church, and track it downstream toward the west for some 460 m at around 15 m over the water; finish on the farm's field.

Fly about 460 m downstream along the river to the west, roughly 15 m above the water, starting near the village of wooden chalets around a white church. Take off from the meadow at the edge of the village and land on the field beside the farm.
easy_mountain_058.short: Follow the river downstream west 460 m at 15 m above the water.

easy_mountain_059.canonical: Lift off from the flat open meadow on the valley floor in the middle of the valley, fly to the easternmost snow-capped peak on the north side of the valley and hold position roughly 85 m away and watch it for 6 seconds, and set down on the flat open meadow on the valley floor west of the stone arch bridge across the river.
paraphrases: Starting on the level meadow in the middle of the valley, fly toward the easternmost snowy peak on the northern side, hover about 85 m from it watching it for 6 seconds, then land on the flat meadow west of the stone arch bridge over the river.

From the open meadow at the valley's centre, go to the north side's most easterly snow-capped peak, hold roughly 85 m away facing it for 6 seconds, and touch down on the meadow to the west of the stone arch bridge.
Watch the easternmost snow-capped peak north of the valley for 6 seconds from about 85 m; take off on the mid-valley meadow and land on the meadow west of the stone arch bridge across the river.
easy_mountain_059.short: Hover 85 m from the eastern north-side peak for 6 seconds, land west of the stone bridge.

easy_mountain_060.canonical: Lift off from the flat open meadow on the valley floor at the eastern end of the valley, head up to the pass in the north ridge, go through the gap about 25 m above the lowest point and over to the other side, then land on the high pasture next to the shepherd's hut.
paraphrases: Lift off from the level meadow at the valley's east end, climb to the pass in the north ridge, go through it about 25 m above the lowest point to the far side, and land on the high pasture beside the shepherd's hut.
From the flat meadow in the eastern part of the valley, head up to the north ridge's gap, cross roughly 25 m over the saddle, and set down on the shepherd's high pasture next to his hut.
Cross the pass in the north ridge with about 25 m of clearance over its low point; you start on the open meadow at the eastern end and land on the high pasture by the shepherd's hut.
easy_mountain_060.short: East-end meadow, through the north pass 25 m up, land at the shepherd's hut.

easy_mountain_061.canonical: Rise from the middle of the trailhead car park, climb to the pass in the north ridge, fly along the ridgeline about 40 m above the rocks for roughly 350 m until the second pale rock tower from the west on the north side of the valley, and set down on the meadow at the edge of the village.
paraphrases: Go up from the trailhead car park's centre to the north-ridge pass, then stay roughly 40 m above the rock while you track the crest for some 350 m, ending at the second pale tower counted from the west on that side. The village-edge meadow is where you land.

Lift off in the middle of the trailhead parking, reach the north ridge at its pass, fly the ridgeline some 350 m at around 40 m over the rock until the north side's second pale rock tower counting from the west, then touch down on the meadow bordering the village.
Follow the north ridge for about 350 m, roughly 40 m above the rocks, from the pass to the second pale rock tower from the west. Start at the trailhead car park and finish at the edge of the village.
easy_mountain_061.short: North crest 350 m at 40 m from the pass to the second pale tower, land at the village edge.

easy_mountain_062.canonical: Lift off from the middle of the trailhead car park, fly to the campground with tents and parked cars and orbit it once counter-clockwise, about 65 m away, filming it the whole time, and finish by landing on the open meadow on the valley floor near the mountain village with the church tower.
paraphrases: Lift off from the centre of the trailhead car park, fly to the campground with tents and parked cars, circle it once counter-clockwise about 65 m out while filming it, and land on the valley meadow near the mountain village with the church tower.

From the middle of the trailhead parking, go to the tent-and-car campground, make a single anticlockwise orbit at roughly 65 m with the camera on it, then touch down on the meadow by the church-tower village.

Orbit the campground with tents and parked cars once, counter-clockwise, about 65 m away, keeping it in view; take off at the trailhead car park and land on the meadow near the mountain village with the church tower.
easy_mountain_062.short: Orbit the campground anticlockwise at 65 m from the car park, land by the church-tower village.

easy_mountain_063.canonical: From the middle of the trailhead car park, take off, go to the cable car's valley station and fly up along the cables to the top station, keeping them about 26 m to your left and staying 15 m higher, then touch down on the meadow at the edge of the village.
paraphrases: From the middle of the trailhead car park, fly to the cable car's valley station and ascend alongside the cables to the top station, keeping them roughly 26 m to your left and 15 m below you, then land on the meadow at the village's edge.

Lift off at the centre of the trailhead parking, reach the lower cable car station and follow the line uphill to the upper station about 15 m higher than the cables and 26 m to their right, before touching down on the village-edge meadow.

Climb beside the cable car from the valley station to the top station with the cables about 26 m to your left and 15 m beneath you. Depart from the middle of the trailhead car park and land on the meadow at the edge of the village.
easy_mountain_063.short: Climb beside the cable car, cables 26 m left and 15 m below; land by the village.

Circle the westernmost rounded hill north of the valley once, clockwise, about 90 m away, keeping it in view; take off east of the campground with tents and parked cars and land on the campsite's grassy edge.
easy_mountain_095.short: Orbit the western north-side hill clockwise at 90 m, land on the campsite grass.

easy_mountain_096.canonical: From the meadow at the edge of the village, take off, go to the cable car's valley station and follow the cable line up to the top station, about 30 m to its left and 20 m above the cables, then come down on the open meadow on the valley floor near the mountain village with the church tower.
paraphrases: Lift off from the meadow at the village edge, go to the cable car's valley station and fly up beside the line to the top station, keeping about 30 m to its left and 20 m above the cables, then land on the valley meadow near the mountain village with the church tower.

From the meadow bordering the village, head for the lower cable car station, climb along the cable line to the upper station roughly 30 m off to the left and 20 m higher than the cables, and touch down on the open meadow by the church-tower village.

Climb beside the cable car line from the valley station to the top station, about 30 m to its left and 20 m above the cables. Start on the village-edge meadow and finish on the valley meadow near the mountain village with the church tower.
easy_mountain_096.short: Up the cable car line 30 m to its left, 20 m above, land by the church-tower village.

easy_mountain_097.canonical: Take off from the open grass at the edge of the campsite, drop down to the river by the stone arch bridge across the river and follow the river downstream (east) for about 430 m, about 20 m above the water, then touch down on the high pasture next to the shepherd's hut.
paraphrases: Lift off from the grass at the campsite's edge, descend to the river by the stone arch bridge, follow it downstream eastward for about 430 m roughly 20 m above the water, then land on the high pasture by the shepherd's hut.

From the open grass bordering the campsite, drop to the river near the stone arch bridge, trace it downstream to the east for some 430 m at around 20 m over the water, and touch down on the shepherd's high pasture.
Follow the river downstream (east) for about 430 m, roughly 20 m above it, starting by the stone arch bridge; take off on the campsite's grassy edge and finish beside the shepherd's hut.
easy_mountain_097.short: River downstream east 430 m at 20 m from the stone bridge, land at the shepherd's hut.

easy_mountain_098.canonical: From the open grass at the edge of the campsite, take off, gain height and reach the north ridge at the easternmost rounded hill on the north side of the valley, follow the crest, about 35 m above it, for about 500 m to the highest rounded hill on the north side of the valley, then come down on the field beside the farm.
paraphrases: Depart from the open grass at the campsite's edge, climb to the north ridge at the easternmost rounded hill, follow the crest roughly 500 m to the highest rounded hill on the north side while staying about 35 m above it, and land on the field beside the farm.

Lift off at the grassy edge of the campsite, gain the north ridge at its easternmost rounded hill, and trace the ridgeline some 500 m to the north side's highest hill, holding around 35 m over the crest; then touch down on the farm's field.

Follow the north ridge for about 500 m at roughly 35 m above the crest, from the easternmost rounded hill to the highest one. Take off from the open grass at the edge of the campsite and finish on the field beside the farm.
easy_mountain_098.short: Follow the north ridge 500 m, 35 m above the crest, to the highest hill.

easy_mountain_099.canonical: Lift off from the open meadow on the valley floor near the mountain village with the church tower, make your way to the mountain farm with the red barn and a fenced paddock and touch down on the field beside the farm.
paraphrases: Starting from the open valley-floor meadow near the mountain village with the church tower, fly over to the farm with the red barn and fenced paddock and land on the field beside it.
Lift off at the meadow on the valley floor close to the church-tower village, make your way to the red-barn farm with its paddock, and put the drone down on the farm's field.
Your landing spot is the field beside the mountain farm with the red barn and a fenced paddock: depart from the valley-floor meadow near the village with the church tower and touch down there.
easy_mountain_099.short: Meadow by the village to the red-barn farm; land on its field.

easy_mountain_100.canonical: From the lakeshore meadow by the boathouse, take off, fly to the valley station of the cable car and climb beside the cable car line all the way to the top station, about 22 m off to its left, 20 m above the cables, then land on the open grass at the edge of the campsite.
paraphrases: Starting at the lakeshore meadow beside the boathouse, head to the cable car's valley station and climb alongside the line to the top station, roughly 22 m off its left side and 20 m above the cables, then land on the open grass at the campsite's edge.

Lift off from the meadow on the lakeshore by the boathouse, reach the lower station and follow the cables uphill to the upper station about 20 m over them and 22 m to their left; finish on the grassy edge of the campsite.

Climb beside the cable car from the valley station to the top station, about 22 m left of the line and 20 m above the cables. Depart from the lakeshore meadow by the boathouse and finish on the open grass at the edge of the campsite.
easy_mountain_100.short: Climb beside the cable car, 22 m left and 20 m above the cables; land at the campsite.
